secrets.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Backend base secret (32+ characters). Sessions, opaque tokens and TOTP-encryption keys are derived from it. Supplied by the Base44 dashboard; .env.base44-defaults carries a development placeholder that the real value overrides.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for transactional email (verification, password reset). Without it, development suppresses delivery and logs the attempt instead, so account email verification cannot be completed.

secrets.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
secrets.description: AWS access key for the AI agent (Claude via AWS Bedrock). Optional: only the agent page needs it.

secrets.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
secrets.description: AWS secret key for the AI agent (Claude via AWS Bedrock). Optional: only the agent page needs it.
